positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented software and database features and improvements of central monitoring and alerting software for hospital environments as part of an international team using C# .Net 8, SQL Server, as well as HTML, CSS, and React as needed.
●	Led the final development and implemented fixes for a PDF generation feature in C#, utilizing PDFSharp and SVG generation libraries to produce printable patient reports with captured waveforms.
●	Collaborated on the design and implementation of a new alert paging system and associated database schema for a distributed user base across a diverse range of devices.
●	Architected, optimized, tested, and documented a major rework of the archive database purge process and scripts, while collaborating with another team to lay the groundwork for replacing the current archive process with their solution with the intent of standardizing across multiple products.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Performance Management · Microsoft SQL Server · Software Development · XML · Code Review · .NET Framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to  designing and refactoring on-prem and cloud to cloud backup and restore software APIs in C# .NET as part of a small team using Agile processes.
●	Designed and implemented .Net Core REST API functionality for various backup storage modes as well as refactoring existing code to meet updated standards for functionality and clarity.
●	Led documentation efforts to effect knowledge transfer and ensure business continuity.
●	Led revamp of Agile process to clearly define ceremonies, story definitions, pointing, and spring planning, which reduced admin overhead for the team and removed points of confusion.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · API Development · C# · Back-End Web Development · Design Patterns · Software Development · Object Oriented Design · SQL · Code Review · Agile Methodologies · Debugging · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Databases · Software Documentation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a small team to develop and provide on-call support for a variety of backend services including high throughput and deployed via AWS to support business operations worldwide.
●	Developed and maintained a high-performance data management service handling over 8,000 requests per minute including designing and implementing asynchronous SNS event emission to enable both event driven and on-demand service interactions.
●	Improved user facing react components by upgrading third party libraries, improving internal API integration, and implementing UI improvements to pages on the primary workflows of the Vistaprint site serving thousands of customers daily.
●	Defined and documented standards for unit, integration, and performance testing of the new Vista asset management API, using domain knowledge  to develop case specific and general tests including investigating testing options and documenting use of chosen testing frameworks.
●	Participated in On-Call and incident management for multiple incidents including responding to a major production incident  impacting service for over 20 Vista domains worldwide and involving the representatives from teams across the company and resulting in working independently to improve cluster monitoring in AWS Kubernetes clusters with New Relic and Terraform.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · API Development · Back-End Web Development · Design Patterns · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Core · TypeScript · Multithreaded Development · Amazon SQS · Software Development · Object Oriented Design · Terraform · Test Automation · XML · React.js · Node.js · Code Review · REST APIs · Front-End Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Databases · Software Documentation · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of a large cross-disciplinary team contributed  to the design and development of Predictive Asset Maintenance software in .Net Framework and later .Net Core using Machine Learning to predict failures in advance, including spearheading major performance improvements, customer defect investigation and remediation, and automated test development.
●	Collaboratively implemented software and SQL Database Performance Enhancements fulfilling Enterprise level scalability and improving key workflow performance over 30%.
●	Led an investigation into multiple overlapping UI and Software bugs leading to significant customer impact, coordinating information between stakeholders, implementation of solutions, and summarizing the investigation results for a wider audience.
●	Acted as Scrum Master, utilizing best practices and SDLC approaches across the team, improved communication channels, and refined the Scrum process for the entire Mtell product.
●	Led the charge on the revamp and improvement of the DevOps pipeline from a timed manual process to a CI/CD build pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Microsoft SQL Server · Design Patterns · Software Development · Object Oriented Design · Message Broker · XML · ASP.NET · Code Review · .NET Framework · Front-End Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Databases · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
A mix of on-call support and ongoing development for internal facing business processes and applications using C#, .NET, VB, and a variety of SQL database types, including triaging issues, executing immediate mitigations where appropriate, and developing longer term solutions where required.
●	Repeatedly responded to off-hours on-call incidents involving business critical systems and processes, quickly determined severity, root cause, and possible remediation options while communicating with business stakeholders, other technical teams, and frontline support.
●	Conducted a wide-ranging investigation over several months across systems supported by four different teams to determine the answer to a question from accounting and present the findings to a diverse group of stakeholders with implications for hundreds of thousands of dollars of product. 
●	Developed a new application to support a new and improved business process with input from stakeholders and end-users. Refined the product based on feedback from the field which improved inventory check-in time from dozens of minutes to single digits.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · API Development · C# · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Back-End Web Development · Design Patterns · On-call Support · Software Development · Object Oriented Design · Message Broker · XML · SQL · Code Review · .NET Framework · REST APIs · Front-End Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Databases

positions.description: Software Engineering Co-Op working primarily with HTML5, Angular, Protractor, and Cucumber to help develop automated testing for an in-development single page web application as part of an Agile team.
